properties.name: The v0.28.0 version bump. reflow2.toml is a registered artifact, so step 1 of a release cut always drifts it. NO DESIGN MEANING MOVES: what a cut means lives in the Release node and its epoch, not in a version string. Accepted BEFORE release_includes_all is applied, so the manifest freezes the shipped value rather than the pre-bump one — the recorded order does this after and pays a gate failure plus a second export for it.
